source: Owner scope brief for Project 23010 second floor, read against approved drawing AR-00 rev MAR.2023.

APT-001.definition: The dwelling unit occupying the main body of the second floor: its bedrooms, salon, dining, kitchen and the circulation that serves them, entered from the main stair landing.
APT-001.note: Membership is deliberately NOT listed. Which spaces belong to this unit is part of what the acceptance test measures; handing the agents the list would be handing them the answer.

APT-002.definition: The domestic-staff accommodation block at the western end of the floor: the staff rooms, their bathrooms, and the service corridor that serves them, reached from that corridor rather than from the main stair landing.
APT-002.note: Defined by how it is served, not by whether it is in scope. Scope is a separate field and a separate question.

zone_not_defined_reason: Project 23010 has no approved zone ontology. In Run 0 A1 segmented the floor into BEDROOM_WING / LIVING_CORE / PRIVATE_WING while A2 used EAST_RESIDENTIAL — different granularity rather than contradiction. There is no definition that says which of those is the zone level, so the field cannot be assigned honestly or scored fairly. Inventing ZONE-001..ZONE-003 to give the metric something to compare would make the test pass by making it meaningless.
